description: This file implements backend APIs for WAN traffic management in the COSA Data Model, including initialization, event handling, thread management, and configuration for DSCP-based traffic counting and reporting via RBUS.

methods.name: WTC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the WAN Traffic Counter, sets up RBUS subscriptions, and configures initial DSCP and sleep interval settings.

methods.name: WTC_EventHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS events for LAN and WAN mode changes, updating internal state and triggering configuration changes.

methods.name: WTC_ApplyStateChange
methods.description: Adjusts thread states based on configuration flags and current mode, starting or stopping traffic counting threads accordingly.

methods.name: WTC_GetCount
methods.description: Retrieves traffic counts from the DSCP tree and formats them into a string buffer.

methods.name: WTC_EventPublish
methods.description: Publishes traffic count events to RBUS for reporting.

methods.name: WTC_SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters in syscfg for DSCP list and sleep interval.
